conversations.conversation:
{{yellow|*Arshiranadurah gives you a thin smile*}}
Desire something of me, vagrant?
I’m =name=, Who are you? I desire nothing. Live and drink.
w
I am Arshiranandurah, a warrior of the Pariahs, you may call me Arshira.
Where are you from? I ... see. Live and drink.
Not to be rude, but I prefer to be candid with those I know and trust. Return to me when your reputation proves your worth, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Aid the Barathrumites and I might feel inclined to carry this conversation forward.
I understand. Live and drink.
Ah, it's you. My barathruumite friends send musings of you, =name=. I owe my debts to anyone who liken to keep the tinker-kin safe and hidden.
Might I be able to help you, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
Tell me more about yourself. What are your services? I desire nothing. Live and drink.
I’m a sellsword, assassin, hunter--many things, should one wish it. Are you interested?
What’s your price? I desire nothing. Live and drink.
Did she? Such a strange thing to ask a stranger.
She said it’d be good for you. I see. Live and drink.
It would, I get restless at the thought of lacking in purpose. I’m only good for so much, you see.
Well, I can use the company if you so choose? I see. Live and drink.
I do, I welcome you in my presence, =name=. May our journeys together bring us great fortune.
As to you, journeyfriend.
Good, is there anything we need before continuing?
I have some more questions.
If I ask for pay, t’will not be in something ... material.
What would you ask for then?
I have a favor, but ... hm. How about this? I’ll travel with you, for now. If you prove to be capable, then I’ll request of you this favor.
Well, wait. What is it? Okay, if you are fine with that? You can’t expect me to just accept that favor even if you request it of me later, why?
I cannot say now, all I can say is that I need someone capable, someone I can trust. Besides, I’ll be sure to take my share of our plunders.
Fine, I hope this doesn’t come to mistake.
Avid? I’m not one to gloat, but understand this--I am a hunter, nothing less, nothing more. The prey I hunt requires that I not only contend with the tools of my foe, but the lands of which that hide them and consume more lives everyday.
Interesting. What do you hunt exactly? I see. Live and drink.
Why, thoughtstuff, of course. Something curated in only the minds of ripened espers, my prey are seeker ospreys and entities who cross into this plane seeking easy meals.
Why hunt espers? Thoughtstuff? I see. Live and drink.
They hunt us, why not?
Thoughtstuff? I see. Live and drink.
Yes, friend. I predate on both the flesh and the mind. My powers must be nourished.
That’s horrible!? I see. Live and drink.
Tis probably true. If the creatures I hunt weren’t assuredly monsters, I'd probably feel more guilt.
I have some other questions. I see. Live and drink.
Could you tell me about your kind? You said you are a hunter? And is that all, what else? Where are you from again? *You look Arshira up-and-down* Your habits remind me of Seekers’ attire?
Actually, nothing. Live and drink.
I'm just a wandering pariah who falls for the occasional flirtings with wanderlust. Good food, strong drink, and the occasional hunt are enough to ease my cravings for excitement. And a bit of dance and song, if the occasion passes by.
Where are you from? I've never seen kind such as yourself, what are you? So would you call yourself an avid wayfarer? I see. Live and drink.
Uncertain. Though I know it is somewhere far from this wild mesa, it eludes me, as does most of my past, heritage, and ancestors.
... you seem know so little of yourself. I see. Live and drink.
{{yellow|*They break their eyes away, gaze only flickering to you for a short moment, Arshira seems almost annoyed*}}
I know enough to keep me alive. Enough to hone this monsterish body of mine into a weapon worth its edge. The past is a dark, dirt-path leading to places you’ve already looted and seen. There’s nothing to be got, naught but nostalgia.
I prefer to look forward.
I've never seen kin such as yourself, what are you? I ... see. Live and drink.
{{yellow|*They look away seemingly uncomfortable, thinking for a moment as they consider how to answer*}}
I can’t say, =name=. I have no guesses. There's but a few of my kind running amuck in these tender-lands, and we despise each other--we see our weaknesses in each other. So we choose to stay apart. Usually from the egg.
From ... the egg? I see, I won’t inquire anymore. Live and drink.
Yes, we rise from eggs as younglings, with bottomless stomachs and immense curiosity. Within a few years of consistently decent nutrition, we reach adulthood and shed our young-skin for the final time, till then we are egglings.
How much is “a few years?” You ... shed? I ... see. Live and drink.
Maybe molt is truer. I renew this shell here and then. Near the end of two-and-a-half months. And before you say anything, no, you cannot watch.
How much is a few years, regarding your growth? I ... see. Live and drink.
To be honest with you, I have no idea. I only know of what my past-family had told me. Two or three.
To grow so quickly, did you even experience a childhood? Past-family? I see. Live and drink.
The young die in Qud. There is no room for innocence here, grow and kill.
You mentioned Past-family? I ... see. Live and drink.
Yes. I was once a Disciple of the Sightless Way, a dervish in the grow.
I see, I have other questions. A dervish? My run-ins with the Seekers has been mostly unpleasant, you seem nothing like them.
You were a follower of the Sightless Way? I ... see. Live and drink.
Yes, a Dervish.
A Dervish Seeker is taught to wield a weapon with the grace of swirling winds. Swordsmanship, polemastery, Axemanship--weapon-forms performed beyond the limitations of the mortal body, instead aided by the mind.
A dervish serves as a personal agent led by the Elder, oft sent on suicide missions or assassinations.
The more one forgoes the lesser sight of the flesh and masters the Sightless Way, the more deadly the Dervish becomes.
The Elder? What should I do if I encounter one? I ... see. Live and drink.
The initiates and intermediates are well-trained, but their thoughtstuff lacks mastery and curation, and so the weapons they bind are blunt and weak. Having even a bit of skill with your arms should pull you through.
But the ones who hold the title arch-dervish? Their minds’ edge cuts the very fabric of the void. Less you have mastered many lives worth of fighting prowess, to fight one on its own terms would be suicide.
To keep a dervish away is to leave them incapable of harm--they relish solely in melee. Put something between you and this dervish and gun them down.
Well, I have other questions. I shall remember this, thank you. Live and drink.
Mm, in a past life. I was forsaken, a lone egg in the deeps of the Moghra’yi. Whilst pilgriming south-east to Qud, Sightless pilgrims discovered me. Their mind’s eyes saw the glimmer I hold and so they convened with the Elder. They chose to let me follow--for a toll.
You were abandoned? I have other questions. The Elder? I ... see. Live and drink.
Let me affirm something to you, your worth to the Seekers amounts to nothing more than feed--a meal. If your thoughtstuff is enough to engorge their gluttonous mass mind that is the Elder, then they’ll be attracted to your light like madpoles to the scent of blood.
Assume most Sightless will kill you on sight--their schemes for power encourages this.
The Elder? Well, I have other questions. I ... see. Live and drink.
{{yellow|*Arshira nods*}}
Another orphan in the waste.
You mentioned an Elder? I have other questions. I see. Live and drink.
{{yellow|*Arshira’s gaze seems unsettled, as if they didn’t want to recall*}}
Those with the glimmer hear voices in the aether; amongst these a ghastly call, a chant as if voiced by countless minds whose cants echo into the void. To unindicted espers, tis like an obnoxious siren, vagrant zealots singing eerie hymns in the void, singing of a reverence unlike any other. You may turn away, but for those Chosen, resisting the call is far harder. The cant heralds from the Elder, but give them no such honor--I only do out of habit. Call them Ptoh.
Who is Ptoh? I see. Live and drink.
Few know who they are, what they are. An entity in the endless cosmos that is the mind. I hear rumors here and there, that they were imprisoned here, in Qud. Usually, at the moment I chose to forget such a life, such a thing.
Makes me anxious, makes me eager. My bloodlust flairs. Revenge is the meal I crave.
You seem ... to harbor some hatred for them. I see. Live and drink.
Some? It's a deeper well than I’d like to admit. This hatred keeps me up at night. Let’s talk about something else.
Well, I have other questions. I see. Live and drink.
